name: Ulf Bourelius
signal: I build systems that make complex work easier to see, reason about and trust.
introduction: My work moves between software design, developer tooling and technical learning. I use code, contracts and careful presentation to turn difficult ideas into things people can inspect and use.
direction: I learn architecture by building: defining authority, exposing state, testing boundaries and documenting the decisions that hold a system together. The aim is not complexity for its own sake, but software whose reasoning remains visible.

provenance.description: Mechanically derived from the controlling public projection.
